user.title: Device Inventory Notes
user.description: Exports device data from Home Assistant as Markdown notes with YAML frontmatter. Hand-maintained fields (e.g. purchase date, warranty, notes) are never overwritten. Download: {zip_link} and {notes_link}.

fields.title: Select fields
fields.description: Choose which fields appear in the notes. Hand-maintained fields (lagerort, menge, kaufdatum, preis, gekauft_bei, garantie_bis, notiz, transport) are created as empty placeholders and never overwritten on updates.

order.title: Field order
order.description: Set the order of fields in the frontmatter: one field per line, top first. Empty lines are ignored. The selected fields are pre-filled.

extra.title: Additional protocols
extra.description: Assign a protocol to integrations whose devices Home Assistant cannot identify. The mapping only applies to devices that otherwise get no protocol; you can correct the value later in each note (updates never overwrite it). Unbekannt groups them under a separate section.

data.export_dir: Export directory (relative to the Home Assistant config dir or absolute)
data.obsidian_base: Obsidian base path of the protocol folders (used by the dataview overviews)
data.schedule_enabled: Scheduled daily run (safety net, also when auto-update is off)
data.schedule_time: Time of the scheduled daily run
data.notify_service: Notification service for push on changes (e.g. notify.mobile_app_xyz; empty = HA-internal notification only)
data.ignored_devices: Ignored devices (device ID or name fragment, one per line)
data.force_include: Force include – e.g. bridges/coordinators (device ID or name fragment, one per line)
data.only_areas: Only areas (area name or name fragment, one per line; empty = all)
data.type_map: Override type labels (format: domain: label, one per line; e.g. light: Lamp)

init.title: Device Inventory Notes
init.description: Controls how and where notes are generated. After each run the export is available as a {notes_link} and as a {zip_link}. Cancel to keep current settings.

scan_and_generate.name: Generate/update device notes
scan_and_generate.description: Generates or updates the Markdown notes for all devices in the export directory. Hand-maintained fields (lagerort, menge, kaufdatum, preis, gekauft_bei, garantie_bis, notiz) are never overwritten. Optionally process only a single device via device_id.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only analyze and return a report, write nothing.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: Process only this device (ha_device_id from the note); empty = all devices. Orphaned notes are not deleted in this mode.
